title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Join RankWatch, a dynamic leader in the Software Development industry, as a UX/UI Designer. With a team of 51-200 dedicated professionals, we are committed to driving innovation and excellence. Our company thrives on values such as Accountability, Belonging, Boldness, and Commitment, which guide us in creating impactful solutions. As part of our mission, we aim to push boundaries and foster an environment where creativity and collaboration flourish. In this role, you will have the opportunity to design intuitive and engaging user experiences, contributing to projects that make a real difference. If you are passionate about creating compelling digital experiences and eager to work in a place where your skills are valued and your growth is supported, RankWatch is the place for you. Become a pivotal part of our team and help us shape the future of software development with your innovative ideas and designs.

**Tasks**
---------

* Collaborate with product managers and developers to create intuitive, user-friendly software interfaces that align with the company's mission and values.
* Conduct user research and evaluate user feedback to improve the overall user experience of our software products.
* Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to effectively communicate interaction and design ideas.
* Develop and maintain a consistent design system and style guide to ensure a cohesive visual identity across all digital platforms.
* Stay updated with the latest UX/UI trends and technologies to propose innovative solutions that enhance the usability and aesthetics of our products.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio showcasing design skills and problem-solving capabilities.
* Proficiency in design and prototyping tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma, or similar software.
* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices, with the ability to translate user needs into intuitive and engaging digital experiences.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

title: IT Engineer,Software,Intermediate
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a IT Engineer, Software (Intermediate) with 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and supporting business-critical web applications. The ideal candidate combines strong front-end development skills with a solid design sensibility, and brings proven expertise in **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** to help build and maintain scalable, component-driven applications on the enterprise content platform.

This role sits at the intersection of design and engineering within the IT Business Applications function — translating wireframes and design systems into responsive, accessible, production-ready interfaces within an AEM-based platform.

* Design and develop responsive, user-centric web interfaces from wireframes, prototypes, and design specifications.
* Build, customize, and maintain AEM components, templates, and client libraries (HTL/Sightly, JS, CSS).
* Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and back-end developers to translate design concepts into functional AEM pages and components.

* Ensure UI consistency by contributing to and maintaining a shared design system / component library.
* Optimize front-end performance, page load times, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility.
* Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback from user testing into design and development iterations.
* Ensure all interfaces meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA compliance).
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve UI-related defects across the AEM platform.
* Stay current with UI/UX trends, front-end frameworks, and AEM platform updates.

Qualifications:

B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computers, IT or other related streams with 3-5 years of working experience with following skills:

  

* 3 - 5 years of experience in UI/UX development, front-end engineering, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience with **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** — component development, templates, HTL/Sightly, Sling models, and client libraries.
* Strong proficiency in **HTML5, CSS3/SASS/LESS, JavaScript (ES6+)**.
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks/libraries (e.g., React, Vue, or similar) integrated with AEM.
* Solid understanding of **responsive and adaptive design** principles.
* Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch).
* Strong grasp of UX principles — usability, information architecture, and interaction design.
* Experience working with design systems and component libraries.
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and Agile/Scrum development practices.
* Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / ADA).
* Strong attention to detail and ability to bridge design intent with technical implementation.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design/technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, Agile teams.
* Problem-solving orientation with a keen eye for detail and design consistency.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* AEM certification (Adobe Certified Expert – AEM Developer).
* Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service.
* Familiarity with headless AEM / GraphQL implementations.
* Exposure to A/B testing and analytics tools (Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
* Experience with cross-functional collaboration in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Basic knowledge of Java/backend concepts relevant to AEM development.

title: AI Designer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy AI Designer who can combine design thinking,

visual storytelling, and generative AI tools to create compelling visual assets for brands. The

ideal candidate should understand design fundamentals while actively experimenting with

AI-powered tools to develop innovative creatives, campaign visuals, product imagery, videos,

and digital content.

You will work closely with the creative, social media, performance marketing, and content teams

to translate briefs into visually engaging, brand-aligned creatives that stand out across digital

platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* AI-Powered Creative Production: Create high-quality visuals, campaign creatives, product images, illustrations, and digital assets using generative AI tools.
* Visual Design Storytelling: Develop creative concepts, mood boards, layouts, compositions and visual directions based on brand briefs and campaign objectives.
* AI Image Video Generation: Generate and edit AI-based images, videos, animations, and other visual content for social media, advertisements, websites, and digital campaigns.
* Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and refine prompts to achieve desired visual styles, compositions, lighting, textures, and creative outcomes.
* Brand Consistency: Ensure all AI-generated and designed assets align with brand guidelines, visual identity, campaign requirements, and platform specifications.
* Post-Production Editing: Refine AI-generated outputs using tools such as
* Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, or other relevant design and editing software.
* Campaign Collaboration: Work with creative strategists, copywriters, social media managers, and performance marketers to develop visuals that support campaign objectives.
* Creative Experimentation: Explore emerging AI tools, design workflows, and new creative techniques to improve output quality, speed, and efficiency.
* Quality Control: Identify and correct visual inconsistencies, distorted elements,
* inaccurate product details, typography issues, and other AI-generated errors before delivery.
* Trend Research: Stay updated with AI design trends, emerging creative formats, and innovative brand campaigns to bring fresh ideas to the team.
* Workflow Optimisation: Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows that help scale creative production without compromising quality or originality.

**Required Skills Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in graphic design, digital design, AI-assisted creative production, or a related field. Candidates with strong portfolios and relevant practical experience may also be considered.
* Hands-on experience with generative AI tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly,
* Claude, ChatGPT image generation, Stable Diffusion, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with AI video tools such as Runway, Kling, Pika, or other comparable platforms is an advantage.
* Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or equivalent software.
* Strong understanding of composition, colour theory, typography, lighting, visual hierarchy, and design principles.
* Ability to write effective prompts and iterate on AI outputs to achieve specific creative requirements.
* Understanding of social media formats, digital advertising creatives, product visuals, and brand communication.
* Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a digital marketing, advertising, creative, or branding agency.
* Experience creating AI-generated product visuals, lifestyle imagery, campaign concepts and branded content.
* Basic knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, compositing, and animation.
* Understanding of performance creatives and how visual variations can support ad testing and campaign optimisation.
* A portfolio showcasing original designs, AI-generated visuals, prompt experimentation,and final post-production work.  
    
  **What We’re Looking For**

  Someone who thinks like a designer, experiments like a creator and uses AI as a creative

  advantage. We value candidates who can go beyond generating images and transform AI

  outputs into polished, purposeful, and campaign-ready visual assets.

title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.

This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
